title: Evidence-coding dataset and reproducible D-by-V heatmap for intelligent process-parameter decision-making in polymer injection molding
description: Supporting evidence dataset and reproducible Figure 4 workflow for the review "Intelligent Process Parameter Decision-Making in Polymer Injection Molding: From Initial Setting to In-Process Adaptation". Version 1.1.0 contains the 151 primary research publications. The primary D/V assignments and matrix are unchanged; the literature cutoff is 27 October 2026, with authentic historical query dates and windows retained. The package includes English S1, matching evidence and method CSVs, plotting input, Python script, dependencies, reference heatmap, licenses and checksums. D and V refer to the same application. Frequencies describe the selected evidence set of a structured critical narrative review, not field-wide prevalence. No literature full texts, private author-review records, permissions, editorial correspondence or raw database exports are included. Data and documentation are CC BY 4.0; Python code is MIT. License scope is specified in LICENSE_DATA.txt and Supplementary/heatmap_generation/LICENSE within the data archive. OpenAI Codex using GPT-6.1 (OpenAI) assisted author-led script refinement and consistency checks; scientific assignments are author-confirmed.
